title: Data Validation Contract
description: Normalized intermediate between parsed source-to-target mapping and the validation plan. Captures target table structure, column lineage, SCD2 metadata, and engine-specific naming conventions needed to generate dialect-neutral validation checks.

key_column.description: Whether column is a primary key

table_type.description: Target table type classification from intent identification

engine.description: SQL engine used for validation query rendering

primary_key_columns.description: Primary key columns that define the grain of the target table

partition_key_columns.description: Partition key columns used for date-scoped validation filtering

source_database.description: Source database name where this column originates

source_table.description: Source table name where this column originates

business_logic.description: Transformation expression from the mapping document (null for direct mappings)

transformation_type.description: Transformation category (e.g., Direct, Derived, Hardcoded, Lookup)

is_audit_column.description: True if this column is a framework audit column (e.g., dw_bus_dt, dw_ins_dt)

is_crypto.description: True if this column undergoes tokenization or detokenization

columns.description: Target table columns with lineage and transformation metadata

scd2_metadata.description: SCD2-specific temporal metadata. Present only when table_type is NonTransactional_SCD2.

eff_start_date_source.description: Source column or expression used to derive the effective start date

high_end_date_sentinel.description: Sentinel value for the high-end date on current (open) records

temporal_boundary_convention.description: Boundary convention for SCD2 date ranges. BUK CDAO uses inclusive (start <= t <= end).

close_logic.description: Expression or rule used to close prior records (null if standard close_insert pattern)

audit_columns.description: List of framework audit column names (e.g., ['dw_bus_dt', 'dw_ins_dt', 'dw_upd_dt'])

control_date.description: The as-of date for validation, rendered as DATE '{{control_date}}' placeholder in generated SQL

validation_mode.description: Validation mode governing which checks are applicable: day0 (initial load), day1 (first incremental), steady_state (BAU)

source_database.description: Athena engine: source database name for 2-part naming (database.table)

source_catalog.description: Databricks engine: Unity Catalog name for source tables (3-part: catalog.schema.table). Resolved value, not a {{placeholder}} token.

source_schema.description: Databricks engine: source schema name for 3-part naming (catalog.schema.table). Resolved value, not a {{placeholder}} token.

target_catalog.description: Databricks engine: Unity Catalog name for the target table (3-part: catalog.schema.table). Resolved value, not a {{placeholder}} token.

target_schema.description: Databricks engine: target schema name for 3-part naming (catalog.schema.table). Resolved value, not a {{placeholder}} token.
